title: GLC_FCS30D global 30 m land cover, 1985–2022
description: Global land cover at 30 m with 35 classes, from GLC_FCS30D v2 by the Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences. There is one map for each of 1985, 1990 and 1995, and one map for each year from 2000 to 2022. Each map is 961 tiles of 5° by 5°, and each tile is one item with a single-band Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF of class values with an embedded color table. The items are grouped by year, then by 10° longitude band. Search them all at once with the items.parquet asset.

providers.name: Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences
providers.description: Produced GLC_FCS30D (Liangyun Liu, Xiao Zhang and Zhehua Li) and publishes it on Zenodo.

providers.name: Portolan Mirrors
providers.description: Maintains this mirror: split each multi-year GeoTIFF into one COG per year and tile, and wrote the STAC metadata, item mirror and documentation.

overview.title: Land cover 2022, whole world (COG)
overview.description: All 961 tiles of 2022 in one 8-bit RGBA image in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) at about 2.4 km, in the class colors. Made from the tiles' internal overviews with mode resampling, so it is for display only.
